notes.title: Write Warz – v01.01.00 Update
notes.notes:
Hi Word Warriors!

We have a huge update for you all today!

[h3]NEW GAME MODE: ROUND ROBIN MODE[/h3]

Round Robin Mode is now fully launched and packed with updates based on community feedback!

[b]What is Round Robin Mode?[/b]
In this mode, players build a shared story—[i]one sentence at a time[/i]. Each player writes a sentence, then passes the story along to someone else. As long as the story is staying active you will continue to get the story back after at least 2 additional sentences have been added to the story.

[b]Here’s how it works:[/b]

[list]
[*] You’re dropped into a story mid-flow and asked to continue it with a single sentence.
[*] Story timers range from 4 hours to 1 week—completely randomized.
[*] Once your turn ends, the story continues with a new writer.
[*] When the story ends, all contributors vote on their favorite sentences in categories like Best Sentence, Plot Twist, and Funniest Moment.
[*] Meet Clocky! Our new in-game assistant gives smart writing tips based on where you are in the story (beginning, middle, or end).
[/list]

This mode is perfect for those who want a slower, more collaborative, and low-pressure way to play. Whether you're building tension, tossing in chaos, or closing out an epic tale—Round Robin rewards creativity at every turn.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979424/a93e15d1d09bc035e0cff6dfba05fba08dd7efb1.png[/img]

[h3]NEW PLOT POINT: MYSTERIOUS STRANGER (HORROR THEME)[/h3]

Something sinister has entered the story...

The [b]Mysterious Stranger[/b] is a new plot point in the Horror theme, and he’s here to test your luck.

[list] 
[*] When he appears, you’ll be offered 3 mysterious words to use in your next sentence.
[*] 2 are safe and offer a bonus if used.
[*] 1 is cursed—choose it, and you’ll lose a chunk of your points.
[*] Use 1 or 2 of the words at your own risk. Choose wisely…
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979424/a4d3c745e2ce1fa9fcda07683f445bdaabe728b6.png[/img]

[h3]VISUAL & UI IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]

[list]
[*] Updated character art
[*] Adjusted font size for end game credits to prevent text clipping
[*] Changed voting button font for improved readability
[*] Resized Pirate voting buttons to match Horror theme
[*] Updated icons for the mode selector
[*] Readout timing adjusted for smoother pacing across different story lengths
[*] Added slider to adjust main menu music and UI sound effects
[/list]

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]

[list] 
[*] Fixed fast-forward bug in Readout that skipped directly to the end
[*] Fixed bug where Readout transition occasionally wouldn’t play
[*] Fixed font brightness issue in the writing input field
[*] Fixed grammar mistakes in Horror stock sentences
[*] Fixed tooltip positioning for the Plank in the shop
[*] Fixed layering issue with Cannons and Lost in the Fog
[*] Fixed bug in Morgana’s Pirate challenge that allowed text to overflow the writing box
[*] Fixed bug in Mummy’s Curse where bottom 3 players didn’t see the bonus word box
[*] Updated profanity list
[*] Fixed bug preventing new font colors from updating in the Scriptorium
[*] Removed the Treasure Map plot point from Pirate (being redesigned)
[/list]

[h3]WHAT'S NEXT[/h3]

We're not done yet! Here’s what’s coming soon in upcoming updates:

[list]
[*] Twitch Integration – Let stream viewers vote on sentences live
[*] AI Overhaul – Smarter, funnier, and more context-aware bots
[*] Text-to-Speech – Hear your story come to life, one ridiculous line at a time
[*] A mysterious new Limited Time Mode inspired by Bumbly’s undying love for rock 'n roll 🎸
[/list]

There’s a lot more coming to Write Warz, and we can’t wait for you to be part of the story—one sentence at a time.

[b]– Boltz Entertainment[/b]

notes.title: Write Warz – Update v01.00.07
notes.notes:
Greetings storytellers!

This patch includes some community-requested fixes, polish for our base characters, and a small quality-of-life feature for those of you streaming your sessions live. Here's what's new:

New Feature: Story Saver Protections
We’ve added a new Story Saver screen designed to protect sensitive info (like internal paths or usernames) during saving—especially helpful for streamers.

Fixes & Improvements
"I think therefore I am" loading screen quote now properly capitalized. Cogito has spoken.

Timer position fix: Corrected a visual issue where the timer would drift off-center. It now sits pretty, especially during those final countdown moments.

Spellchecker refinement: Reduced overcorrection on possessives (like 's). More polish is coming in future updates.

Visual Touches
Character art touchups: We updated ~80% of the base characters with refined shading and detail. Still more to go, but the core cast is looking better than ever.

Credits update: Added missing artist credits to show love where it's due.

As always, thank you for all your feedback and chaos. We’ll see you—one sentence at a time.

– The Write Warz Team

notes.title: Write Warz Early Access Launch - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Ahoy, storytellers! The wait is over — Write Warz has officially set sail into Early Access! 🚀

We want to extend a massive thank you to everyone who supported us on Kickstarter and helped us test throughout our demo phase. Your feedback, creativity, and dedication have been invaluable, and we can’t wait to continue this journey with you.

Now, let’s dive into everything new in this Early Access launch!

[b][h3]New Writing Pass & Market[/h3][/b]
Each season will introduce a brand new Writing Pass featuring two new characters, a brand-new theme, and tons of skins, fonts, colors, and more to unlock. Level up to earn more rewards!

[b][h3]High Seas Adventure Theme Arrives[/h3][/b]
ARGH Maties! Pirates have invaded Write Warz, bringing rum, cannonballs, and plenty of high seas chaos. Take on the role of a pirate captain, managing your ship, crew, and resources while writing your way to legendary status. Sing-alongs, sea monsters, buried treasure, and more await!

[u]Port Trading & Economy[/u] 💰 
Before each round, visit a port where you can buy & sell goods. Each port has specialties, meaning some items will sell for more, while others will be cheaper to buy.

[u]Port Items & Mechanics[/u]
🪙 Doubloons – Earned through writing, voting, winning rounds, and selling goods. Convert them to points at the end for extra strategy!
🪵 Planks – Used to repair ship damage from attacks or failed plot points. Ports charge high repair fees, so stock up!
💣 Cannonballs – Attack your opponents! Blast their screens with water & random letters while they try to write.
🍹 Rum – Scramble your bonus word into a piratey version. If used, it’s worth extra points!
🍊 Citrus – Adds 5 extra seconds to your timer when you run out of time (Max 1 per round).
🎯 Bounties – Purchase Word Bonus bounties to use in your next sentence for extra points!

[b][h3]More Custom Game Options![/h3][/b] [list]
[*] Single Round Voting – Move all voting into one large round instead of separate voting phases. Perfect for groups who want to read and discuss stories together.
[*] Map Rotation – Matchmaking now rotates between themes every hour!
[/list]
[b][h3]New Playable Characters![/h3][/b]  
[u]Morgana - The Pirate Duelist[/u] 🏴‍☠️ 
[list]
[*] As Morgana types, she fills her Word Chest.
[*] At 550 characters, she can challenge a player to a duel. 
[*] Whoever speed-types a sentence fastest wins! If Morgana wins, she steals 50 points.
[/list]
[u]Cedric - The Honorable Knight[/u] ⚔️ 
[list]
[*] Cedric loves Word Bonuses!
[*] For every 5 used, he can challenge the top half of players with a chosen word.
[*] All challenged players must use the word, and if Cedric places higher than them, he steals 10 points and gains 20 points! [/list]
[b][h3]General Updates & Fixes 🔧[/h3][/b]  [list]
[*] New Tutorial for the Scriptorium – Learn how to unlock and customize your writing style.
[*] Profanity Filter Updates – Adjusted to allow non-offensive words.
[*] Time & Speed Controls – Control the story readout speed at the end of the game.
[*] New Accolades – More fun intermission awards.
[*] Moonlit Inspiration Fix – Longer pause before the beam comes down.
[*] Tiebreaker Fixes – See your own sentence in a three-way tiebreaker.
[*] Digital Services Act Compliance – Game now follows EU regulations.
[*] Win Screen Update – Prevents text clipping during victory sequence.
[*] Reconnect Feature – You can now reconnect into matches!
[*] New Credits & Attribution Screen – Added to the main menu.
[*] Word Bonus Highlighting – Bonus words now glow gold when they appear in the story.
[*] New System Messages & Text Effects – Improved readability and clarity.
[*] Bug Fixes – Various small fixes to visuals, UI, and characters like Eli & Evelyn. [/list]
[b][h3]Thank You Again!⚡ [/h3][/b] 
We can’t wait to hear your stories and see what legendary tales you create in Early Access! If you haven't already, wishlist the game and jump into the adventure today! ✍️

See you on the high seas! ⛵🏴‍☠️

[/list]

[h2][b]Good Judgement in Write Warz:[/b][/h2]

Good Judgement is an essential mechanic in Write Warz that rewards players for voting on the sentence that ends up winning the round. It’s not just about earning points but also about shaping the story by choosing the sentence that best fits the narrative. Choosing wisely ensures that the story flows seamlessly and that you stay competitive in the game, even if your own sentences aren’t always the winning ones.

Before: Good Judgement previously had a base value of 15 points. Each time you voted correctly, this stacked with a 2x and eventually a 3x multiplier, allowing players to earn up to 45 points per round just for voting for the best sentence. This system has been in a good spot, so we're not adjusting the point values. However, if you win a round (since you can’t vote for yourself), or if you vote for the wrong sentence, you lose your Good Judgement points. This mechanic keeps you in the game and competitive, even when your sentences aren’t always on top.

After: We’ve made visual changes to streamline the Good Judgement system. Instead of cluttering the screen with the 1x icon, we’ve removed it (you’ll still get your 15 points) and now it will jump straight to the 2x icon for a cleaner display.

Good Judgement Adjustments: This update simplifies the interface without altering the core function, making it easier to track your Good Judgement multipliers while continuing to reward smart voting. Choose wisely to influence the story and gain the advantage!

notes.title: Write Warz Version 1.1 Update: New Features and Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Write Warz Version 1.1 Changelog

Version 1.1 is out! Here’s what’s new and improved:

Enhanced Clarity on Play Options:

Core Gameplay Experience: Write Warz is fundamentally a party game, best enjoyed with 3-6 human players. We’ve received valuable feedback and understand that, as a new genre, it can sometimes be challenging to grasp. We're committed to improving this experience.

Invite Friends: If you have friends who enjoy crafting stories or sharing a good laugh, invite them to join your custom lobby. Our code system works similarly to Jackbox or Marvel Snap, making it easy to connect with friends.

Online Matchmaking: While online matchmaking will be available in Early Access, we’re currently focusing on building our community to ensure a seamless experience. In the meantime, join our Discord to connect with other players and find games.

New Features and Improvements:

Steam Friend Invites: You can now directly invite your friends into your custom lobby through Steam!
Social Buttons Added: We’ve added social buttons to the main menu to help you easily connect with our community, find games, and chat with other players.

Character Ability Tooltips: Tooltips for character abilities now only appear when hovering over the icon, rather than the entire character card. This change provides better clarity when selecting your champion.

Widescreen Monitor Support: We’ve temporarily fixed widescreen monitor support. Full widescreen support will be implemented during our Early Access phase.

General Bug Fixes:

UI Layering Issues: We’ve fixed some layering issues with UI elements—just a bit of technical housekeeping on our end.

Dialogue Boxes: Fixed an issue where dialogue boxes were disappearing inconsistently. Oops! We deleted those too fast.

Witching Hour Plot Point Fixes:

Timing Text: Resolved an issue where the timing text wasn’t showing “0” during Witching Hour.
Potion Animation: The potion in the Witching Hour Plot Point now moves and spins faster for a more dynamic experience.

Player Status Text: Added new text to indicate when a player is waiting for others during the Witching Hour Plot Point.

We hope these changes enhance your gameplay experience. Thank you for your continued support, and don’t forget to join our Discord to connect with other players and share your stories!

Join our community: www.discord.gg/writewarz

Happy storytelling!
The Boltz Entertainment Team
